title: Quran Study 49: Code 19 and the Heavenly Feud (1989-11-05)

cases.question: Why was the miracle called perpetual?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad says anyone anywhere can verify the Quran's mathematical code. He refers to the Metonic calendar cycle, 209 bones, and a 266-day full-term pregnancy as multiples of nineteen and God's signature in creation.

cases.question: Which natural multiples of nineteen were cited?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad says anyone anywhere can verify the Quran's mathematical code. He refers to the Metonic calendar cycle, 209 bones, and a 266-day full-term pregnancy as multiples of nineteen and God's signature in creation.

cases.question: How were the verse-number and God-reference totals constructed?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad explains writing every verse number sequentially, counting digits, totaling verse references containing the word God, opening pages at random to verify occurrences, and summing all explicitly mentioned numbers to 162,146, a multiple of nineteen.

cases.question: What total came from Quranic numbers?
cases.expected_answer_note: Rashad explains writing every verse number sequentially, counting digits, totaling verse references containing the word God, opening pages at random to verify occurrences, and summing all explicitly mentioned numbers to 162,146, a multiple of nineteen.

cases.question: What did Satan claim?
cases.expected_answer_note: The presentation shifts to the heavenly feud. God delegates powers to creatures, Satan claims he can independently rule a dominion, angels uphold God's authority, and rebels divide into those who repent and the hardcore humans and jinn who continue the challenge.

cases.question: How were creatures classified?
cases.expected_answer_note: The presentation shifts to the heavenly feud. God delegates powers to creatures, Satan claims he can independently rule a dominion, angels uphold God's authority, and rebels divide into those who repent and the hardcore humans and jinn who continue the challenge.

cases.question: How did creation demonstrate submission?
cases.expected_answer_note: Animals, mountains, trees, stars, the sun, and the moon follow God's law without deviation. Halley's Comet is used as an example of predictable submission. Humans are said to have doubted again even after receiving a second chance.

cases.question: Why was Halley's Comet mentioned?
cases.expected_answer_note: Animals, mountains, trees, stars, the sun, and the moon follow God's law without deviation. Halley's Comet is used as an example of predictable submission. Humans are said to have doubted again even after receiving a second chance.

cases.question: How did Abraham illustrate natural instinct?
cases.expected_answer_note: A hypothetical isolated person can discover God through natural instinct, as Abraham did by observing the heavens. Satan's world is judged by disease, starvation, earthquakes, cancer, and AIDS, which Rashad treats as evidence that Satan cannot manage a perfect dominion.

cases.question: What evidence was offered against Satan's rule?
